meta.source: Printed menu of Steinofen Pizzeria Niki, Wesel (photographed). Currency EUR. Allergen codes not transcribed.
toConfirmWithRestaurant: Which ingredients may be added as an extra topping (the list here is every ingredient that appears on the menu).
Prices read with doubt: 14 Hawaii and 15 Mediterrane (larger sizes), 151 Quattro Formaggi (price partly hidden, read as 8,50).
107 Insalata Pollo: the printed description is cut off.
140 Napoli: the number is partly hidden.
The six items flagged as popular are an invention for the demo.
Pizza Niki is a surprise and is marked non-vegetarian to be safe.
notModelled: Angebot 1 and 2 (bundles) and company prices: offers, not menu items.
